messages.content: I've been feeling really stressed after my SPY trade yesterday. It was a losing trade and I just can't shake it off.
What about it is stressing you the most?
I don't know, maybe just the fear of losing again. I get so tense after taking a hit.
What do you usually do when you're in a winning trade?
Honestly, I tend to take profits as soon as I see a gain. It's like I'm worried it'll disappear if I wait too long.
And how does that affect your overall trading?
I guess I miss out on bigger moves. Like with AAPL last week, I sold too early. I just don't have the patience to let it ride.
If you had to rate your patience on a scale of 1 to 10, where would you stand?
I'd probably say a 3, if I'm being real. It's definitely something I need to work on.
